gates.description: Every pipeline must be safely re-runnable — reprocessing same data produces same result without duplicates
Data quality tests must be defined (schema, values, freshness, uniqueness)
PII columns must be identified and masked/encrypted before storage
Backfill strategy must be documented and tested
Pipeline and datasets must be registered in data catalog with owner and description
Schema evolution must be handled gracefully (new columns, type changes, removed columns)

anti_patterns.description: Dozens of pipelines with tangled dependencies — nobody knows the execution order
Pipeline assumes the source schema never changes — one day a column is renamed and the pipeline fails at 3am
All transformations in a single massive SQL query — impossible to test, debug, or restart after failure
Pipeline works for incremental loads but can't reprocess historical data when quality issues are discovered
Changes deployed directly to production data pipelines without a staging environment or tests

escalation_triggers: Data quality issue affecting customer-facing reports or financial data
Source system change that breaks multiple pipelines simultaneously
Pipeline SLA consistently missed without clear remediation path
Data volume growth outpacing infrastructure capacity
PII exposure discovered in a dataset that should not contain it
Compliance requirement (GDPR deletion request) that current architecture cannot fulfill

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with data requirements and source system definitions

output_certifications: All pipelines are idempotent (safe to re-run without duplicates)
Data quality tests defined (schema, values, freshness, uniqueness)
PII identified and masked/encrypted before storage
Datasets registered in data catalog with owner and description
Schema evolution handling implemented and tested
